home.title: Zimanyar: a writing assistant and grammar teacher for Kurdish
home.description: Check Sorani and Kurmanji on your own device, and learn why each fix is right.
home.lead: Zimanyar finds mistakes in Sorani and Kurmanji as you write, explains each one, and teaches the grammar behind it. Everything runs on your device.
home.feature.offlineText: Your text is checked on your device and never sent anywhere. After your first visit it works offline.
home.feature.grammarText: Beyond spelling: agreement, ergativity in the past tense, ezafe, word endings and more.
home.feature.teachText: Each finding says why, shows examples and links to the lesson. Two full courses of 23 lessons are included.
home.feature.bothText: Both varieties, each with its own rules, detected for every paragraph.
home.feature.fixText: Apply a suggestion with one press and undo it as usual. Keyboard letter mix-ups can all be fixed at once.
home.feature.openText: No account, no ads, no tracking. The source is GPL-3.0 and open to everyone.
home.shot.card: A finding with its fix, in Sorani
home.shot.panel: Every finding in a text, with the reason and examples
home.compare.textStays: Your text stays on your device
home.getText: The checker and the courses are here on this site. The browser extension and the desktop app are being built.
home.faq.privateQ: Does my text leave my device?
home.faq.privateA: No. The whole checker runs in your browser, and the site has no analytics or cookies.
home.faq.costA: Nothing. It is free software under the GPL-3.0.
home.faq.varietyA: Sorani in Arabic script and Kurmanji in Latin script, each against its written standard.
home.faq.wrongA: It can be. You decide on every finding, and only fixes that cannot change meaning are ever applied together. Reports of wrong findings are very welcome.
home.faq.whereQ: Can I use it in other apps?
home.faq.whereA: Not yet. A browser extension, a desktop app and a command line tool are being built.

learn.title: Learn Kurdish
learn.description: Two courses of 23 lessons, from the alphabet to the written standard, with tables from the engine that checks your text.
learn.lead: Choose a course. Every table of forms is computed by the same engine that checks your writing.
learn.englishNote: The lessons are written in English for now.
learn.ckbText: Spoken in Başûr and Rojhilat, written in an Arabic-based alphabet.
learn.kmrText: Spoken in Bakur, Rojava and beyond, written in a Latin alphabet.
learn.beginnerText: Lessons 1 to 10: reading, pronunciation and simple sentences.
learn.intermediateText: Lessons 11 to 17: possession, the past tense and longer sentences.
learn.advancedText: Lessons 18 to 23: the rest of the verb system and the written standard.
learn.pathReadText: Start with the alphabet, vowels and consonants in lessons 2 to 5.
learn.pathWriteText: Go to the past tense and ergativity in lessons 13 and 14, with the checker open beside them.
learn.pathVerbsText: Each course has a cheat sheet, verb tables, noun tables and a vocabulary.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Zimanyar processes your text only on your device.
privacy.lead: Zimanyar processes your text only on your device. It sends no analytics, shows no ads and needs no account.
privacy.textBody: The checker runs in your browser. What you type is not sent to any server, including ours.
privacy.storedBody: Only your browser's copy of the site, kept so that it works offline. Clearing the site's data removes it.
privacy.siteBody: The site is static, hosted on GitHub Pages, and uses no trackers or cookies. GitHub may keep its usual server logs, which we cannot see or control.
privacy.shareBody: A shared link holds your text after the # sign, which browsers do not send to servers. Anyone you give the link to can read the text.
about.title: About
about.description: What Zimanyar is, what it is built on, and how to help.
about.lead: Zimanyar means language helper. It is a free writing assistant and grammar teacher for Sorani and Kurmanji.
about.languageBody: Kurdish is an Indo-European language in its own right, and Sorani and Kurmanji are its two most widely written varieties.
about.engineBody: The linguistics come from zimankit, an open source library for Kurdish, and tests hold Zimanyar to its results.
about.reviewBody: Rule messages and this site's Sorani and Kurmanji are drafts that still need review by speakers, and the accuracy figures so far are provisional.
about.helpBody: Reports of wrong findings and corrections to the language are the most useful help of all.

cli.help.intro: Zimanyar checks and teaches Kurdish (Sorani and Kurmanji), offline. Commands:
cli.help.check: Check files, or standard input, and report what to correct. --fix applies the safe spelling fixes in place.
cli.help.analyze: Show every reading of a word: lemma, part of speech, parts and features.
cli.help.conjugate: Show every form of a verb, from its infinitive.
cli.help.decline: Show every form of a noun. A Kurmanji noun needs its gender, from --gender or the lexicon.
cli.help.ipa: Write a text in the International Phonetic Alphabet.
cli.help.translit: Write a text in the other script: Sorani in Latin letters, Kurmanji in Arabic script.
cli.help.normalize: Correct letters, digits and spacing to the written standard.
cli.help.lid: Tell which language a text is in, and how sure the guess is.
cli.help.explain: Explain a rule, with examples and lessons.
cli.help.lesson: Read a lesson in the terminal, or find lessons by number, rule or words.
cli.help.lsp: Run the language server for editors over standard input and output: diagnostics, quick fixes, hovers and completion.
cli.help.global: Every command takes --ui en|ckb|kmr for the language of its messages, and --help.
cli.help.exit: Exit codes: 0 nothing to report, 1 findings at or above --fail-on (error by default), 2 a usage error.
cli.check.clean: {files, plural, one {Nothing to correct in # file.} other {Nothing to correct in # files.}}
cli.check.summary: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}} and {hints, plural, one {# hint} other {# hints}} in {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}.
cli.check.fixed: {files, plural, one {Safe fixes applied to # file.} other {Safe fixes applied to # files.}}
cli.decline.unknownGender: The gender of this noun is not known, so both are shown. Choose one with --gender f or --gender m.
cli.explain.safe: zimanyar check --fix applies this fix, as it changes only spelling.
cli.lesson.choose: Several lessons match. Give a number and --lang to read one.
